mapper.sql: BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, FSUBJECT_ID as fsubjectId, BAL_FLAG as balFlag, SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, ACC_QUA_FLAG as accQuaFlag, ACC_INT_FLAG as accIntFlag, OVERDRAWN_FLAG as overdrawnFlag, BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE as baseSubjectNature, CREATE_USER as createUser, CREATE_DEPT as createDept, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_USER as updateUser, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT SUBJECT_NO code,SUBJECT_NAME name,SUBJECT_NAME shortName,SUBJECT_NO hidCode,SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) >= #{subjectLevel}
AND (SUBJECT_NO like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR SUBJECT_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%')
order by SUBJECT_NO

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_LEVEL id, SUBJECT_LEVEL text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) >= ( select DISTINCT to_number(SUBJECT_LEVEL) from BOK_SUBJECT where SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} )
AND SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{search}
order by SUBJECT_LEVEL

SELECT DISTINCT A.SUBJECT_NO code,A.SUBJECT_NAME name,A.SUBJECT_NAME shortName,A.SUBJECT_NO hidCode,A.SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT A LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT B ON A.SUBJECT_NO = B.FSUBJECT_ID AND A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID WHERE B.SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT A.SUBJECT_NO code,A.SUBJECT_NAME name,A.SUBJECT_NAME shortName,A.SUBJECT_NO hidCode,A.SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT A LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT B ON A.SUBJECT_NO = B.FSUBJECT_ID AND A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID WHERE B.SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL
AND (A.SUBJECT_NO like '%' || #{param} || '%' OR A.SUBJECT_NAME like '%' || #{param} || '%')
select count(1) from BOK_SUBJECT where BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} and SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo}
